explication: Prisma 8 is an extensible TypeScript ORM. The principal workflow is: a developer or agent authors a PSL contract, the tooling parses and indexes it, contract/target validation produces SQL or Mongo storage IR, and the ORM executes application queries against the selected database. The graph also preserves the editor/LSP, migration, extension, and telemetry branches documented or represented by the tree. Some execution and migration callers were not sampled, so those links are intentionally conservative.
